_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: Poisson admissions at 0.8 a year x gamma frailty x 0.7 if treated; frailty independent of treatment, so the marginal rate ratio is 0.7

agreement.claim: both engines report the same log rate ratio, robust and naive standard errors and interval
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: below 1e-6 on every key. With lifelines' own robust=True the robust SE differed from R's by 0.023 (0.0472 against 0.0701); a from-scratch sandwich in harness/survival2_examples.test.py matched R, and that test keeps the lifelines comparison as a standing control.

recovery.claim: the log rate ratio is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: At 600 people the miss (0.26) nearly equalled the effect (0.36); the fixture uses 1000.
